title: Would Giants really trade Dexter Lawrence? As John Harbaugh deems 'everybody tradable,' here's what to consider

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Would Giants really trade Dexter Lawrence? As John Harbaugh deems 'everybody tradable,' here's what to consider
sources.description: A factor that could quash a trade: what the Giants want for Lawrence, based off his broader body of work, may not align with what other teams want to pay for him, based on a statistical dip last season.
